description:
Make `CaptureSpec`'s growth methods validate only the entries they add, so growing a spec one request at a time is linear.

## Background

- `discover_paths`, `discover_tail` and `discover_listings` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/image.rs:566-612`) clone the whole spec, add the request and re-run `validate` (`:660-686`) over every held path, listing and pinned request. `discover_pinned` (`:620-629`) already validates only its request.
- Every check in `validate` is per entry (depth within `max_depth`, `ensure_semantic`, `validate_pinned_request`) or a count (`listings.len()` within `max_listings`), and every mutator goes through these methods, so every held entry is already valid.
- `discover_paths` refuses a whole read of the event log, a per-entry check.
- `RepositoryImage::close` validates the spec once (`:705`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `discover_paths`, `discover_tail` and `discover_listings` validate only the entries a call adds plus the listing count, and clone nothing; a refused call leaves the spec unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: A proptest shows that, for generated specs and batches, a batch is accepted exactly when whole-spec validation of the grown spec succeeds, and that the grown spec is the same either way.
- [hard] REQ-03: A unit test shows that a refused batch leaves the spec equal to its prior value.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Capture specs validate only added entries
